name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko Babić's journey in motorsport began not in the grandstands, but in a small Zagreb garage, tinkering with go-karts alongside his father, a passionate amateur racer. After earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Zagreb, Marko eschewed a traditional career path and immersed himself in the world of racing. He started as a junior engineer at a small Formula 3 team, rapidly progressing through the ranks due to his sharp technical mind and unwavering dedication.

His leadership potential became evident during his tenure as chief engineer for a World Endurance Championship team, where he led the team to multiple podium finishes. Marko's demanding nature is legendary within the paddock; he expects nothing less than perfection from his team. However, this is tempered by his ability to foster a creative environment, encouraging his engineers to push the boundaries of innovation. His distinctive approach blends rigorous technical analysis with a willingness to take calculated risks, a philosophy that has served him well throughout his career.

At Arrow McLaren, Marko aims to build a winning culture, combining cutting-edge technology with a relentless pursuit of excellence. He believes in empowering his team to think outside the box, whilst maintaining a disciplined, data-driven approach. Marko's hands-on leadership style and deep understanding of motorsport engineering will be key to Arrow McLaren's success in the years to come.
